The GCC patch identifies the allocation size adjustment as specific to the fallback implementation. The exact Debian amd64 libstdc++ ELF implements the affected entry point with posix_memalign. Both CI archives and the independently checked Debian package contain this ELF. The decision covers the exact Debian 13.8 OS scanner group and expires independently of Debian's unchanged source-package status. Grype retains the original High finding.

Debian ships Pod::Text in perl-modules-5.40. The gate requires the exact perl-base package and refuses the module filenames, including files hidden by whiteouts. It admits only the seven reviewed Debconf homonyms when their bytes, regular-file type and permissions agree in every layer and the matching Debconf package is installed. Grype retains the High finding.

The reviewed Debian .deb places Archive::Tar in perl-modules-5.40. The exact perl-base package omits it. The image gate requires the matching installed perl-base identity, refuses the companion package and other known suppliers, and checks every image layer for the module filenames, including links and whiteouts. The High finding remains visible in Grype.

The maintainer change in progs/infocmp.c is present in the verified Trixie ncurses-bin rebuild. The three other package matches are grouped by the Debian source. This decision is limited to the exact OS finding and validates the installed receipt, package identities, patched ELF, measured stock providers and absence of the original infocmp bytes across layers.
